capabilities.text: Choose the two metals, each standing in a solution of its own ion
Join the electrodes through a digital voltmeter, a dial voltmeter or a coil of wire
Name the metals, solutions and salt bridge, or leave them off for students to fill in
Mark the anode and the cathode with their signs
Draw arrows for the electron flow
Print an answer key: the anode, cathode, E°cell, both half-reactions and the balanced overall reaction
Type your own E°cell instead of the value from the table
capabilities.note: ours' custom value (voltage_source=Custom) changes only the meter reading; the answer key still works E°cell out from the table
